Solution: Created the base TUNEprint web application. Integrated ACRCloud API to match humming and singing to songs, setting up the core audio recording flow.
The app was initially basic. We added a modern, responsive UI, smooth animations, and clear feedback.
Results didn't have play links. We added direct YouTube and Spotify buttons for every matched song.
Humming audio was noisy and caused bad matches. We added an audio optimizer to clean, enhance, and trim silence before searching.
The app asked for microphone permission on every single search. We fixed it to only ask once.
Users couldn't tell if their voice was being heard. We added an animated microphone input bar.So that they can tell if their audio is being recorded or not.
The recording timer wouldn't stop automatically. We fixed the timer logic to stop and reset properly.

Emailed ACRCloud support if i can build my own custom database with telugu songs as the prediction of the telugu songs are a bit inaccurate but they confirmed they do not support custom humming databases.
The app struggled with regional songs. We created a hybrid engine combining lyrics transcription and the iTunes Search API alongside humming.
Compared OpenAI Whisper and Deepgram for lyrics transcription. Chose Deepgram because of its generous $200 free tier credit which was ideal for the project.

Problem: Switching from iTunes to YouTube API
Solution: The previous iTunes integration was limiting our search capabilities as the itunes api predicts correctly only when the exact spellings are provided.Therefore, We replaced it entirely with the YouTube Data API for a more expansive music database.
Discovered the YouTube Data API provides a free tier of 10,000 credits per day, which restricts the app to approximately 100 searches daily. Noted this limitation for future scaling.
Lyrics search returned random videos instead of songs. We optimized the search filter to strictly find music tracks.
We added an optional language dropdown (Hindi, English, Telugu) to help the AI accurately understand the sung words.
We implemented a clean dark/light mode switcher to improve the overall visual aesthetics and user experience.

Successfully deployed the application to Vercel. Encountered a minor oversight where the live website lacked the secret API keys, which was quickly resolved by adding them directly in the hosting dashboard.
Improved the search logic to handle slight typos in singing and find smart matches instead of exact phrases.
Added safeguards to prevent the app from crashing when song data was missing titles or other information.
Added behind-the-scenes error logs to easily identify what was breaking during a search.
Capped the max results and stopped showing lyrics matches if the humming match was already highly accurate (96%+).
Updated the About page with tips reminding users to allow microphone access, pick a language, and ensure clear audio.
